question: Can a genuinely distinct publicly accessible native EMC treated/untreated or time-course measured perturbation output support one useful unanswered contrast beyond primary prior art?
scope_before_any_outcomes: Source metadata/methods/identity/condition/control/library units and actual public data availability only. Owner source scope must be coordinated before retrieval; reuse verified R1–R9 gates and exact caches.
eligible_not_automatic_finding: Actual native human EMC identity with every relevant perturbation/control/timepoint, defensible donor independence and public measurement linkage. Published static tissues, a cell-line/drug response, response narratives, RNA model signatures or deposited methods do not authenticate new native paired assay.
fields: All EMC diagnoses and ambiguous generic labels, molecular authentication limits
Donor IDs and pre/post treatment or timepoint/specimen links
Perturbation, actual comparator/control, assay types and units
Technical replicates versus donors; cohort overlap/source aliases
Exact public raw/processed measurement locations and sizes, not a promised deposit
Primary prior-art same contrast and practical next measurement affected
prospective_defeat_rules: No native EMC identity or no explicit perturbation/control/timepoint crosswalk
Access remains private/request-only/pending or actual output assay unsuitable
Same question already answered in primary publication and no useful new validation
Batch, donor, purity, treatment history, specimen or timing confounding defeats the intended contrast
Missing contrary conditions or favorable source subset would support only selected outcomes
strongest_alternatives: Treatment-response selection, prior therapies and unmatched tissue site/time
Cell-line or xenograft identity transferred to native tumor
Donor reuse, technical replicate inflation and static subgroup mistaken as perturbation
Purity, viability, fixation and platform/batch change mistaken as measured adaptation
future_value_stage: Only if real public all-EMC outputs and a consequential unanswered contrast survive, freeze one exact question, controls, assay-specific statistic/units, uncertainty and disproof; independent lead review required before values. No outcomes or numeric stage authorized by this plan.
reuse_exclusions: No unchanged models/drug/staticRNA/IR/APA/TempO-clock eligibility repeats; TMEM266 shelved. Restricted FAP-tissue/glycan/structural-genomics/HLA bodies remain unexamined; no access bypass/private routes/logins.

operational.image_rule: Check actual clock immediately before any source roster image; no image/medical-pixel/outcome selection in initial source metadata gate.
operational.no_spend_GPU_outreach_publication: True; root alone sharedGit/main/push; Codex author+committer; originals/fullcatalogues ignoredcacheonly; originalfreezes immutable.

coverage: All actual eligible EMC conditions and ambiguous source units must be dispositioned. Bibliographic inventory not evaluation; pending suitable blocks promotion. No absent biology, paper-worthy invented-hypothesis failure or global exhaustion.
